steps.en: On macOS 10.10–10.15, disable SIP, install MacForge, then Flashlight
steps.zh: 老版 macOS 上关掉 SIP，装 MacForge 和 Flashlight

steps.en: Install plugins in the app, or write a bundle whose examples.txt marks the slots
steps.zh: 装插件，或写插件包并在 examples.txt 里标出槽位

steps.en: In plugin.py, turn the filled slots into a result title
steps.zh: 在 plugin.py 里把填好的槽位变成一条结果标题

steps.en: Injected into Spotlight, matches each typed query against plugin examples
steps.zh: 注入 Spotlight，把你输入的查询和各插件的例句比对

steps.en: Calls the plugin's results() and shows its title as a row inside Spotlight
steps.zh: 调用插件的 results()，把标题显示成 Spotlight 里的一行

steps.en: When you press Enter, calls the plugin's run() with the run_args
steps.zh: 你按回车时，用 run_args 调用插件的 run()

value.en: The native Spotlight bar answers your own queries — but only on macOS 10.10–10.15
value.zh: 原生 Spotlight 能回答你自定义的查询——但只限 macOS 10.10–10.15

sources: https://github.com/w0lfschild/Flashlight/tree/master/Example%20Plugins/Simple%20Say%20Plugin/say.bundle (examples.txt: say ~message(Good Morning); plugin.py: def results(fields, original_query), run_args, def run)
